entries.title: Crewmates can correct the words around a pull request's story
entries.body: When you ask, a crewmate can fix the words above or below the change story on an open pull request, such as an outdated summary or a breaking-change note. The story itself stays exactly as published. If someone changed those words after the crewmate read them, nothing is changed and the crewmate sees the current words.
entries.noPicture: This changes what a crewmate can write where your project lives, not a view in the app.
